primaryGitHubFeedback.finding: Reporter later confirmed their plugin manifest was stale through v1.0.15 and fixed in v1.0.16; the corrected Catalog was read back. No Store code defect remained.

additionalDiscoverySource.handling: parse only exact-root GitHub repository links in the single-plugin table; external directory is discovery evidence only

gates: remote main still equals baseCommit and every precondition hash matches
curated feed parsing accepts only bounded, canonical root GitHub repository URLs and records pinned-source evidence
stale deleted feed links are skipped individually and renamed repositories resolve to their live canonical URL
each source gets a fair bounded scan slot and duplicate repositories retain merged provenance
feed-discovered repositories use the same full fixed-Commit scanner as GitHub-search discoveries
external feed metadata cannot grant installability or bypass the Catalog admission policy
negative tests cover malformed/truncated inputs, unsafe URLs, duplicate sources, source starvation and discovery-only records
no third-party install, prepare, build, test or runtime code is executed
CI-checked auditable pull request based on the exact precondition Commit
rollback: Close the source PR or revert only its scoped files; do not mutate the Catalog, contact ledger, DSH Profile, official inventory, or third-party repositories.
